papers.title: Scan-Strategy Dependent Microstructural Modulation in L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V Components Through Selective Rescanning
papers.abstract: Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) can enable in situ microstructural tailoring of metallic components by precisely controlling the layer-wise processing parameters. Layer rescanning is one such strategy used to induce localized microstructural modification. In this study, we investigated the effect of a lattice-based selective rescanning approach applied to different base scan strategies for Ti-6Al-4V samples. The lattice regions were selectively rescanned at 50% reduced laser power relative to the initial scan along the same laser path. Relative density, porosity, martensitic α′ morphology, phase fraction, and Vickers microhardness were compared with those of non-rescanned reference counterparts. Different scan strategies, including unidirectional, stripes, and chess, exhibited distinct responses to selective rescanning, resulting in localized variations in martensitic phase formation and hardness values. The extent of localized microstructural modification and hardness enhancement was strongly governed by the underlying scan strategy. Selective rescanning using the stripes strategy yielded the largest contrast between non-rescanned and rescanned regions. The unidirectional strategy showed strong effects of rescanning, but the heat-affected zones extended to the non-rescanned regions. In contrast, the chess strategy exhibited comparatively moderate changes owing to its inherent thermal-management characteristics. These findings demonstrate that selective rescanning can provide an effective, localized approach for tailoring microstructure and hardness enhancement in L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V, with its effectiveness strongly dependent on the underlying scan strategy.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了选区重扫描对LPBF Ti-6Al-4V显微组织和显微硬度的影响，但未涉及疲劳或拉伸力学性能，与用户关注的机械/疲劳性能方向相关性较弱。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue or tensile mechanical data; only microhardness results without comprehensive mechanical characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区重扫描策略对LPBF Ti-6Al-4V显微组织和硬度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同基础扫描策略（单向、条纹、棋盘）并进行选区重扫描（功率降低50%）。
summary_zh.result: 条纹策略产生最大硬度对比，单向策略热影响区扩展，棋盘策略变化适中。
summary_zh.validation: 通过相对密度、孔隙率、显微硬度和显微组织表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how selective rescanning with reduced power affects microstructure and hardness in L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V components under different base scan strategies.
summary_en.method: Lattice-based selective rescanning at 50% lower laser power was applied to unidirectional, stripes, and chess scan strategies, and compared to non-rescanned references.
summary_en.result: The stripes strategy yielded the largest hardness contrast between rescanned and non-rescanned regions, while unidirectional showed extended HAZ and chess exhibited moderate changes.
summary_en.validation: Validation involved relative density, porosity analysis, microhardness mapping, and microstructural characterization of martensite morphology and phase fraction.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究LPBF Ti6Al4V过程中的金属蒸汽凝结物，不涉及力学或疲劳性能，与用户关注点无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not provide any mechanical or fatigue characterization of Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses solely on acquisition, characterization, and ignition behavior of metal vapor condensate.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF Ti6Al4V过程中金属蒸汽凝结物的获取及特性。
summary_zh.method: 通过特定收集装置获取凝结物，并用SEM/EDS表征和点火测试。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了凝结物的形态、成分及点火行为。
summary_zh.validation: 实验表征与点火测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To acquire and characterize metal vapor condensate formed during laser powder bed fusion of Ti6Al4V, and assess its ignition behavior.
summary_en.method: Condensate was collected using a dedicated setup and analyzed with SEM/EDS, followed by ignition tests.
summary_en.result: The study reports the morphology, composition, and ignition characteristics of the metal vapor condensate.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization and ignition tests verify the findings.
